blocks.label: What is Chewlandia Academy?
paragraphs: Chewlandia Academy is the next chapter in the world of Chewlandia.

In Grades K–3, students explore Little Chewlandia, where the talking Cutlery Family guides them through stories and adventures. Beginning in Grade 4, students cross the bridge into Chewlandia Academy, where familiar Chewlandia houses become schools and the Cutlery Family becomes their mentors, teachers, and community leaders.

Each Academy school features a four-week mission made up of four week-long quests. Through chapter books, food experiences, friendship mysteries, and hands-on challenges, students solve problems, strengthen relationships, and grow together.

blocks.label: Confetti Cake Cottage School
paragraphs: One of these schools is Confetti Cake Cottage School—a vibrant gathering place where joy is shared, creativity is celebrated, and every student has a seat at the table.

This is where the village comes alive. Music drifts through the air, colorful creations fill the halls, and students come together through challenges, celebrations, food, and shared experiences. From classroom traditions to unforgettable events, every gathering is an opportunity to strengthen friendships, build confidence, and create lasting memories.
At Confetti Cake Cottage School, students discover that community isn't something that happens by accident... it is something we create together.

blocks.text: Because sometimes the most meaningful learning doesn't happen in a lesson. It happens when we gather, celebrate, support one another, and feel like we belong.

paragraphs: Restore the Sparkle is Confetti Cake Cottage School’s four-quest mission. Quest One, The Bake-Off Betrayal, can stand alone or begin the full adventure.
When a team switch strains friendships, students follow clues, explore different perspectives, and discover what it takes to make things right.

items.title: Activate
items.text: Complete the Activate activities before beginning the five parts. Students meet their guide, discover Callie Cupcake, and begin collecting clues.

items.title: Part One: Set the Table
items.text: Students are introduced to this week's Friendship Mystery while building the background knowledge they'll need to begin their investigation.

items.title: Part Two: Secret Ingredients
items.text: Students read Chapter 1, collect clues, examine character choices, and build evidence to explain what caused the friendship conflict.

items.title: Part Three: The Showdown
items.text: Students step into the story through a hands-on challenge that allows them to experience one of the relationship challenges from the mission.

items.title: Part Four: Chew On This
items.text: Students use evidence from the story and The Showdown to test their theories, examine different perspectives, and discuss what the clues reveal.

blocks.label: Your Quest. Your Pace.
paragraphs: Each quest can stand alone or form part of a four-week mission. Quest 1 unfolds across five flexible parts over 1–2 school weeks. Follow the lesson plans for a simple, ready-to-go path through the adventure—you do not need to complete every activity.
Most core parts are designed for approximately 45-minute classes. Choose the Small Bites that work for your class. The Showdown may need more time depending on your challenge.

blocks.label: Want More Time?
paragraphs: Choose additional activities and extensions to stretch the adventure. Activate introduces the adventure before Part 1, and Celebrate offers an optional way to wrap up the experience after Part 5.
